m1.typescript: m1 an orchestrator plans runs a worker per subtask and combines

e1.typescript: e1 the plan is read from prose cleaned capped and replaced when unusable

e2.typescript: e2 one failing worker does not stop the others or the answer

e3.typescript: e3 a draft is revised with the feedback until the judge accepts it

e4.typescript: e4 when the rounds run out the best draft wins and an unreadable judge scores zero

e5.typescript: e5 a label is read from the reply and anything else takes the default route

e6.typescript: e6 the majority answer wins and a tie goes to the one seen first

e7.typescript: e7 a writer that fails ends the loop with the best draft so far

wrong-no-cap.defect: runs every subtask the planner lists instead of the first max_subtasks

wrong-stop-at-first-failure.defect: stops running workers after the first one fails

wrong-no-feedback.defect: revises without sending the judge's feedback to the writer

wrong-last-draft.defect: returns the last draft instead of the best one when the rounds run out

wrong-trust-unreadable-judge.defect: scores a judge reply it cannot read as a pass

wrong-punctuation-kept.defect: does not strip punctuation around the label, so a reply of Billing. misses its route

wrong-tie-goes-last.defect: breaks a voting tie in favour of the answer seen last
